service.description: Fence probe + admin-app route guard: returns the operator identity when the caller passes the DARPAN_ADMIN_API artifact fence and the isSuperAdmin() content gate. A non-super-admin caller is denied at the artifact layer before this body runs.

parameter.name: ok
parameter.description: True when the caller is a super admin.

parameter.name: adminSessionInfo
parameter.description: Operator identity for the admin app shell.

service.description:
DAR-ADMIN-008. What is running on this instance right now, across every tenant: each in-flight reconciliation, automation and audit run with its stage, progress and health, the automation slots and overdue schedule, failures in the last 24 hours, this JVM's load, and the warnings that follow, critical first.
Run health compares a run with its own last successful run, because heartbeats tick only inside the extract stages: a long compare with a silent heartbeat is not stuck. System figures describe the one JVM that answered. A source that could not be read is listed in unavailable, never reported as zero. Rules: darpan.admin.LiveOperationsRules.

parameter.name: warnings
parameter.description: severity (critical | warning), code, title, detail, tenantLabel, runResultId, automationId, since. Critical first, then oldest first.

parameter.name: running
parameter.description: One row per RUNNING run result: kind (audit | automation | run), name, tenant, currentStage, progressPercent, startedDate, elapsedMs, usualDurationMs, health (healthy | slow | stuck), healthReason.

parameter.name: overdue
parameter.description: Active automations past their fire time by more than one scan tick and not still running, latest first.

parameter.name: slots
parameter.description: inFlight and cap (darpan.reconciliation.automation.maxConcurrentExecutions, instance-wide), plus pending executions.

parameter.name: recentFailures
parameter.description: windowHours, count and items: failed run results in the window, newest first.

parameter.name: system
parameter.description: Heap, heap after GC, process CPU, load average, threads, disk on the runtime volume, the Moqui worker pool and uptime. Null when unreadable.

parameter.name: unavailable
parameter.description: source and reason for each source that could not be read.
